proof_format_finding.piqd_proof_pipeline: piqd re-solves the byte-identical CNF with cadical `--unsat` plus binary DRAT regardless of the job's solver_profile (piqd/src/runner.rs: solver::cadical::run_with(&cnf_replay, timeout_s, Some("--unsat"), ...)), then runs `drat-trim <cnf> <drat> -L <lrat>` and accepts the LRAT only on exit 0 plus a whole-line `s VERIFIED` (piqd/src/proof.rs run_drat_trim / accept_drat_trim_output), then densifies clause ids with piqd_lrat::compact_lrat after piqd_lrat::detautologize (piqd/src/proof.rs compact_via_piqd_lrat).
proof_format_finding.compaction_semantics: piqd_lrat::compact_lrat renumbers clause ids only (inputs through the detautologize map, learned clauses densely from n_input_kept+1); hint signs and literals are preserved. Negative hints in the compacted LRAT are therefore drat-trim RAT hints, not an encoding.
